purpose: Extract exact current competition keys for all Single League worlds after normalization
sql: SELECT gw,competition_key FROM (SELECT 'GW001' gw,competition_key FROM `GW001_IMC Results` WHERE competition_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(competition_key)<>'' UNION SELECT 'GW001' gw,competition_key FROM `GW001_IMC Match Report` WHERE competition_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(competition_key)<>'' UNION SELECT 'GW004' gw,competition_key FROM `GW004_IMC Results` WHERE competition_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(competition_key)<>'' UNION SELECT 'GW004' gw,competition_key FROM `GW004_IMC Match Report` WHERE competition_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(competition_key)<>'' UNION SELECT 'GW005' gw,competition_key FROM `GW005_IMC Results` WHERE competition_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(competition_key)<>'' UNION SELECT 'GW005' gw,competition_key FROM `GW005_IMC Match Report` WHERE competition_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(competition_key)<>'' UNION SELECT 'GW006' gw,competition_key FROM `GW006_IMC Results` WHERE competition_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(competition_key)<>'' UNION SELECT 'GW006' gw,competition_key FROM `GW006_IMC Match Report` WHERE competition_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(competition_key)<>'' UNION SELECT 'GW009' gw,competition_key FROM `GW009_IMC Results` WHERE competition_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(competition_key)<>'' UNION SELECT 'GW009' gw,competition_key FROM `GW009_IMC Match Report` WHERE competition_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(competition_key)<>'') x GROUP BY gw,competition_key ORDER BY gw,competition_key
